action.code: const bottle = window.scene.children.find(c => c.userData.name === 'bottle'); if (bottle) { const evt = new PointerEvent('click', {clientX: window.innerWidth/2, clientY: window.innerHeight/2}); window.canvas.dispatchEvent(evt); }

postconditions: Bottle is selected and bottleSelected state is true
Bottle emits soft glow indicating active state

action.code: const startY = window.innerHeight * 0.4; const endY = window.innerHeight * 0.7; ['pointerdown','pointermove','pointermove','pointermove','pointerup'].forEach((t,i) => { setTimeout(() => { const y = startY + (endY-startY)*(i/4); window.canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(t, {clientX: window.innerWidth/2, clientY: y, buttons: t==='pointerup'?0:1})); }, i*150); });

postconditions: Bottle height reduced by more than 15% from original
Vertices displaced downward with spring forces active
Deformation energy accumulated in spring system

action.code: const centerX = window.innerWidth/2; const centerY = window.innerHeight/2; ['pointerdown','pointermove','pointermove','pointermove','pointerup'].forEach((t,i) => { setTimeout(() => { const x = centerX + (i*30); window.canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(t, {clientX: x, clientY: centerY, buttons: t==='pointerup'?0:1})); }, i*150); });

postconditions: Bottle width increased by more than 20% from original
Lateral bulge visible with radial vertex displacement
Spring oscillation frequency measurable from jiggle motion
Refraction beam activates and passes through bottle geometry
Beam path calculated based on bottle deformation shape
Refraction angle computed from surface normals

action.code: const adjustments = [-20, 15, -10, 25]; adjustments.forEach((dx, i) => { setTimeout(() => { const x = window.innerWidth/2 + dx; ['pointerdown','pointermove','pointerup'].forEach((t,j) => { setTimeout(() => window.canvas.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(t, {clientX: x, clientY: window.innerHeight/2, buttons: t==='pointerup'?0:1})), j*100); }); }, i*800); });

postconditions: Beam aligned with sunglasses lenses through deformation adjustments
Color channels begin unlocking sequentially (RGB)
At least 1 color channel unlocked, progressing toward 3
All 3 color channels unlocked (RGB complete)
Prismatic fluid begins filling bottle from bottom
Fluid level rises progressively toward 100%
Scene remains stable for 60 seconds
Bottle maintains filled state with all channels unlocked
Soft-body physics continue with gentle oscillation
All state values remain valid and within expected ranges
